name: Cache-based Lazy Memory Management
definition: A system that scales 3DGS to large scenes on a single consumer-grade GPU by offloading Gaussians to CPU memory and loading them only when necessary, exploiting the inherent sparsity of 3DGS memory access patterns.
summary: Cache-based Lazy Memory Management enables training large 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes on consumer GPUs by caching only active Gaussians and overlapping communication with computation.
